keyVerseDR: "Arise, take up thy bed, and go into thy house." (Mk 2:11)

level1.title: Friends Through the Roof
level1.story: Four friends carried a man who could not walk. The house was too full, so they lowered him through the roof! Jesus forgave his sins and healed him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How did the friends get to Jesus?
How can you help a friend?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for forgiving me. Amen.

activity.title: Sacraments of healing
activity.intro: Jesus forgave and healed. Match each sacrament to its picture.

level2.title: The Paralytic Through the Roof
level2.story: So many people crowded around Jesus that there was no room, even at the door. Four men brought a paralyzed man, opened the roof, and let his mat down in front of Jesus. Seeing their faith, Jesus said, "Son, thy sins are forgiven thee." Some scribes thought, "Who can forgive sins, but God only?" To show He had power to forgive, Jesus said, "Arise, take up thy bed, and go," and the man got up and walked out.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus forgive sins before healing?
Who can you 'carry' to Jesus by prayer?
level2.prayer: Jesus, thank You for forgiving my sins. Amen.

activity.title: I'm sorry
activity.intro: Jesus forgives sins. Write a note to say sorry to someone.

art.mainBrief: Friends lowering a paralyzed man through the roof
